'''Commissioner''' was the title of the leader of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kynachi]].<ref name="TCWSM1">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 3: Duel at Shattered Rock]]''</ref> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Star Wars Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' places events prior to this story in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> the Commissioner was [[Langu Sommilor]]. After the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone trooper]] group [[Breakout Squad]] conducted a [[Mission to Kynachi|mission]] to his world, Sommilor agreed to meet [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] on the Republic capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Sommilor and his [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Mission to Vaced|diverted]] to [[Vaced/Legends|Vaced]] to meet up with Breakout Squad. After landing at [[Vaced Spaceport]], Sommilor and the pilots were assassinated by a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]]. Some time later, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Nuru Kungurama]] discovered that the commissioner and his pilots were still alive and was impersonated by agents of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] organization.

==Behind the scenes==
The title of Commissioner, along with Langu Sommilor, appear in [[Ryder Windham]]'s [[2011]] book ''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 3: Duel at Shattered Rock]]''.
